Name: AstroMapObj
Notes:
An object class designed specifically for the Comet Observatory and its multiple stages of activation. Otherwise inherits most arguments from SimpleMapObjFarMax.

Object will "activate" or start active (having already played its activation animations) if certain conditions are met.

Obj_arg0.Name: Collected Grand Star
Obj_arg0.Description:
Defines what Grand Star is required for the object to activate.

*Additionally enables the kitchen smoke effect when set to 3.

SW_APPEAR.Description: Appears when this switch is activated.

SW_AWAKE.Description: Enables rendering and resumes updates when this switch is active.

DemoCast.Description: Can take part in a cutscene.
